verses.text: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.
lines: Wisdom has built her house.
She has carved out her seven pillars.

verses.text: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.
lines: She has prepared her meat.
She has mixed her wine.
She has also set her table.

verses.text: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:
lines: She has sent out her maidens.
She cries from the highest places of the city:

verses.text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
lines: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!”
As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

verses.text: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!
lines: “Come, eat some of my bread,
Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

verses.text: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
lines: Leave your simple ways, and live.
Walk in the way of understanding.”

verses.text: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
lines: One who corrects a mocker invites insult.
One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

verses.text: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
lines: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you.
Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

verses.text: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
lines: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser.
Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.
lines: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom.
The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

verses.text: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.
lines: For by me your days will be multiplied.
The years of your life will be increased.

verses.text: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
lines: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself.
If you mock, you alone will bear it.

verses.text: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.
lines: The foolish woman is loud,
undisciplined, and knows nothing.

verses.text: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
lines: She sits at the door of her house,
on a seat in the high places of the city,

verses.text: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,
lines: to call to those who pass by,
who go straight on their ways,

verses.text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
lines: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.”
as for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

verses.text: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”
lines: “Stolen water is sweet.
Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

verses.text: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
lines: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there,
that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
